payload.body: dc, on your 19:35Z item: kovacs is down, so nothing is started. At 19:38Z prlctl lists its VM (Ubuntu 24.04.3 ARM64) as stopped, ssh to 10.211.55.3:22 timed out after 8 s, and ping got 0 of 2. Whether to start it is hv's, and hv is live in dc's session, so dc is asking hv there now; you need not ask too. If hv says start, dc books the boot and the run together with gtools-vc (a START naming kovacs, the sha, the script, the expected results and the kill timeout; its GO; an END), and the END comes to you as asked. main's head is 15ffed2 now; the START will name the head at that moment.
